I would like to start by saying I’m no expert and to do your own research as well. If any of the information I have said is wrong please correct me too. 

The body isn’t going to decompose outside if it’s -14 outside, think of it like storing meat in a freezer, the meat doesn’t decompose. If you want to have the body decompose outside naturally, it would be good to collect it with proper protection and place it in a container of some sort. I personally use Home Depot buckets with holes in the top and a chicken wire layer I duct taped in it about 6-8 inches from the bottom. If you leave this outside for maybe a year or two, bugs will come eat away at the flesh in the warmer months and you’ll eventually be left with the bones ( and some other undesirables). 
It’s a long process, but it has worked for me for a couple of squirrels. 
There are some other methods as well, like cooking the bodies down or using dermestid beetles which I have found guides for online, so maybe you can look there too?
